title: NVIDIA Robotics Learning Engineer Dai Shiqin Announces Resignation Due to Jensen Huang's Sudden Departure
excerpt: Darrell Dai, a robotics learning engineer at Nvidia, recently announced that he will leave the company. He said Jensen Huang’s sudden departure was a key reason
content_html:
Darrell Dai, a robotics learning engineer at Nvidia, recently announced that he will leave the company. He said Jensen Huang’s sudden departure was a key reason for his decision, and admitted, “Jensen Huang’s departure made me especially disappointed.”

Dai said Huang was far more than a CEO. He admired that Huang had invested in CUDA before the deep learning boom, made early moves in AI, and continuously pushed the development of robotics and physical AI; this foresight laid the foundation for the company’s core competitiveness. More importantly, Huang shaped the corporate culture: personally reading employees’ “Top5” emails and communicating directly, which made engineers feel their ideas could still be heard.

He found it hard to accept facing this turn of events without sufficient explanation, and felt uncertain about the future direction, culture, and employees’ sense of belonging. Although he does not prejudge the investigation, his admiration for Huang does not mean Huang is exempt from scrutiny. Huang’s vision and culture were important reasons he stayed, and now he has decided to close the chapter of his time at Nvidia. He leaves with sadness and gratitude.

After Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and from other roles on November 12, the company entered a transition period. Dai’s statement reflects some employees’ concerns about the transparency of the leadership transition and the continuity of the culture.
